newsitem.title: CROATIA: Fully-listed Zagreb stocks soar in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Fully-listed Zagreb stocks soar in active trade.

text.p: Fully-listed stocks Zagrebacka Banka, Pliva and ship repairer Viktor Lenac dominated the Zagreb bourse on Wednesday, trading high volumes with prices soaring.
"Zagrebacka was fantastic, selling 1,200 shares all at 2,200 kuna. It has gained some 10 percent in the past few days," Zoran Ilic of Consultinvest brokerage told Reuters.

Drugs firm Pliva was very active as well, trading in the 515-525 kuna range after closing at 508 kuna on Tuesday and doubling its volume to more than 5,000 shares by 1000 GMT. Ilic said the strong dollar was a possible factor.
Viktor Lenac was also among the gainers, its prices ranging between 165 and 171 kuna after yesterday's close at 156 kuna with some 6,000 units changing hands.
There are four fully-listed stocks trading in Zagreb and 15 other companies in the semi-regulated segment of the bourse.
